summary: Select one contextual declaration or statement owner at a source-item boundary without semantic lookup or post-marker fallback; product parser NOT_RUN.
requires: source role and activation profile are fixed before the source-item probe
the probe uses one checkpoint and only lexical or syntactic DPG evidence
failure before a row marker consumes zero tokens and emits no diagnostic
a reached marker commits the declaration and forbids expression or trailing-closure fallback
annotation selects AnnotatedItem and therefore has no statement fallback
symbol, type, overload, import and source-order lookup counts are zero
preconditions: scanner token and trivia stream is lossless
exact source role and activation profile are known
DPG and ParserContext digests are bound
normalization: preserve contextual spelling and optional visibility; normalize only the selected row ID and source owner
decision_procedure: take one token checkpoint before optional visibility and contextual starter
probe only the thirteen ordered structural rows admitted by the selected profile
on no marker restore the checkpoint and, only in a script without annotation, parse a statement
on a marker commit the row's declaration owner
if the committed declaration fails emit SOURCE_ITEM_CONTEXTUAL_DECLARATION_INCOMPLETE without fallback
preserve the row and marker span in lossless CST but emit no commitment node in normalized AST
termination_metric: one finite thirteen-row table and one finite syntactic token span bounded by the current source item
evaluation_order: selected role/profile -> annotation/visibility wrapper -> closed row probe -> marker commit or zero-token rollback -> declaration/statement parse -> deterministic diagnostic
